answer: Standing comes from a random walk, not a headcount. Each epoch honest seed agents launch short walks across the staked trust graph, and your weight is how often such a walk ends on your vertex. A sybil ring joins the honest side only through a narrow wharf of a few purchased edges, so walks seldom wander into it and the trickle that does splits among all the clones, each near zero. To give N fakes real standing the attacker must buy N genuine bonded edges from N distinct honest anchors, so cost scales linearly as N times real staked collateral.
